At start of turn, if unit is within 2 spaces of an ally, grants Def/Res+6 to unit and allies within 2 spaces for 1 turn. If a foe uses bow, dagger, magic, or staff and initiates combat against an ally within 2 spaces of unit, triggers【Savior】on unit. If unit triggers Savior, grants Atk/Spd/Def/Res+4 during combat.
【Savior】
Unit takes ally's space, enters combat in ally's place, and receives all after-combat effects.
Savior will not trigger if ally is on terrain that unit cannot move to or if multiple units are able to use Savior during the same combat. If Savior triggers, after-combat movement effects do not occur.

builds.name: Legendary Buffer
builds.desc:
Simple build that has two main purposes: Tanking and buffing. One may be skeptical upon seeing that I replaced the coveted Fierce Breath skill with the everyday Fury 3, but when taking Legendary Tiki's stat spread and insane BST, it maintains her enemy phase potential while giving her a powerful player phase as well. When Tiki gets moderately damaged, her brazen skil will activate and she'll be able to deal even more damage (and also defend against mages better). Her tanking potential is obvious when looking at her C slot skill, With Everyone, and her good innate speed (which we'll talk about in a sec). Finally, she will do extraordinarily well with buffing as she will be able to give +5 Def/Res and +6 Atk/Spd to anyone.
Now, most people waste Legendary Tiki's speed, which is already alright for defending. However, this build will ensure she'll double most enemies when combining her base speed with her Atk/Spd Link 3 skill (which you can obtain from Halloween Niles). When fully buffed with her OWN skills including her Brazen (and assuming the IVs above), Legendary Tiki will have 69 Atk, 44 Spd, 44 Def, and 41 Res. And this is without summoner support and merges. With Summoner Support and full merges, you can up this to 75 Atk, 50 Spd, 51 Def, and 47 Res. Basically, you'll break the game. Have fun.
